scope: Same source f845..f865, VLM-chosen camera variants BASE left20, D right35, E left45; all original DD weights. Scores are diagnostic, visual whole-video review required.

BASE.holistic_visual_quality: All 21 frames: person and rooftop coherent; small but visible left20 Stage2 parallax, Stage3 leg extends in broadly source-like timing. Late hand remains near head versus source hand forward; face/hand soft. Relative scene continuity strongest of three but orbit modest.

D.holistic_visual_quality: All 21 frames: stronger right35 Stage2 parallax and full person/rooftop retained. Stage3 upper body leans/curls forward through middle; hand moves toward front and late arm pose appears closer to source, but raised leg extension lags or differs from projected source (f20 leg mean ~30px versus BASE ~11px). Dark building shows pale reconstructed window patches from middle to late, modest scene artifact. No holistic pass.

E.holistic_visual_quality: All 21 frames: left45 orbit visibly stronger but Stage2 endpoint already has a large ghosted tower/roof structure on right, persisting in Stage3. Dancer remains visible but small, lifted leg stays more bent while source extends, and action changes weakly. Fails holistic scene/action quality despite all frames decodable and detector finding human.

caveat: Same source but different target views: compare projected source pose to each native result in its own target camera. DWPose/geometry can fail in black holes; low matched count is not success. Mesh/contrast do not certify image quality.
visual_ranking: E clearly weaker on background/action. BASE versus D is a tradeoff: BASE cleaner scene and more source-like leg, D stronger camera effect and somewhat better arm; no proof that either is globally or user-preferred best. Await actual VLM native feedback and human continuous playback.
geometry_validation_caveat: E source-to-warp projected keypoints match only 22 joints (2/21 frames detected) versus BASE249 and D171; E native target-pose numbers should not be trusted as precise action fidelity. D warp projection median17.45px is weaker alignment than BASE9.12px, so D 27px late arm figure is advisory. Visual evidence controls.
